verdict.rationale: Gusto runs some processes automatically in the background: it pre-generates scheduled regular payrolls and calculates and files taxes automatically. Developers can also build their own event-driven automation on webhook subscriptions (e.g. payroll.paid), and the CLI supports headless CI/scripted operation with env-var tokens. However, there is no user-facing automation or workflow builder, any scheduling must come from external tooling, and the agent-friendly CLI deliberately blocks writes until a human passes --confirm and cannot submit payroll. missing for 10: native user-configurable background automations or scheduled agent tasks, autonomous execution without a human confirmation gate, independent corroboration of automation in practice.
